title: Extract fieldwork::inbox module with DB queries
description:
Now that fieldwork owns the schema, extract inbox handling WITH persistence into fieldwork. Combines inbox_verify (kc30.22) with the Follow/Accept/Undo dispatch logic that was previously too DB-coupled.

Source: BS server.rs:755-1100 (inbox handler), GJ inbox.rs, SH inbox.rs.

Module split:
1. Verification (pure logic, no DB — from kc30.22):
   - verify_digest(body, digest_header) -> Result<()>
   - verify_date_freshness(date_header, max_skew) -> Result<()>
   - Already designed in kc30.22, implement here

2. Follow handling (uses fieldwork::db::Pool):
   - handle_follow(pool, client, follower_actor_uri: &str, target_persona_id: &str) -> Result<()>:
     - SSRF validate follower actor URI and derived inbox
     - Fetch follower actor document (fieldwork::fetch_remote)
     - Upsert into remote_accounts
     - Insert into followers (dedup via UNIQUE constraint)
     - Build and send Accept activity (fieldwork::activities)
   - handle_undo_follow(pool, actor_uri: &str, target_persona_id: &str) -> Result<()>:
     - Look up remote_account by actor_uri
     - DELETE from followers

3. Dispatch:
   - InboxActivity enum { Follow, Accept, Undo, Delete, Other }
   - parse_inbox_activity(body: &Value) -> InboxActivity
   - process_inbox(pool, client, activity: &Value, verified_actor: &str) -> Result<InboxResult>

Deps: cavage-httpsig, ssrf-guard, reqwest, serde_json, sqlx via db features, sha2, base64, subtle (constant-time compare).

Security: This is the most security-critical module. Digest verification, signature verification, date freshness, SSRF checks, and body size limits must all be correct and consistent.

Supersedes: fedistract-kc30.22 (inbox_verify). The verification logic is incorporated here rather than as a separate module, since it's always used together with the dispatch.
